sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate preserves the required ship-level conditional branches, optional additional-power operand, kW quantities, and tolerance direction, but it is not faithful to verificationMode DIRECT_STATIC: both sh:SPARQL constraints perform arithmetic, COALESCE, ABS, and IF-based derived-value comparisons. DIRECT_STATIC must use direct checks over the supplied static RDF state; do not introduce calculation logic under this mode.
